## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

The *Tatiyapāṭidesanīya* ("Receiving food from a designated family") is the third rule in the Pāṭidesanīya section of the Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga in the Vinaya Piṭaka. The rule stipulates that a monk who accepts food from any family or person designated as "in training" (*sekha*) must formally acknowledge the offense. An English translation of the text within the Vinaya Piṭaka has been made by Bhikkhu Brahmali.
